meaning:
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל),
Zerubbabel (1Ch.3:19, al.): Mat.1:12-13 Luk.3:27.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Zorobabel

elsewhere.note: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
